## What changed

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] No credentials or third-party raw data are included.
- [ ] Prediction-time availability and as-of semantics are preserved.
- [ ] Train, validation, and test periods remain disjoint.
- [ ] Generated files and large artifacts are excluded unless essential.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for user-facing or operational changes.

## Evidence

List commands, synthetic fixtures, metrics, or screenshots used to verify the
change. For research changes, state the baseline and pre-registered rejection
condition.
